explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/517 (Fejér–Pólya): if f(z) = Σ a_k z^{n_k} is entire with all a_k ≠ 0 and n_k/k → ∞, does f assume every value infinitely often? Open. The statement uses HasFabryGaps (strictly increasing n with n_k/k → ∞), nonzero coefficients, and pointwise HasSum on all of ℂ, which forces f to be entire. It asserts every fibre {f = z} is infinite. Faithful.
